Container.Name: itemized
Container.Overview: Self-hosted household inventory management with barcode/QR scanning, direct LAN Zebra ZPL label printing (IPP & Raw TCP 9100), OpenFoodFacts UPC lookup, optional LLM classification, and OIDC authentication.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for Itemized Web UI and API

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for running Itemized and owning /data files (99 = nobody on Unraid)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for running Itemized and owning /data files (100 = users on Unraid)

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Public URL encoded in printed QR labels (e.g. https://itemized.example.com)

Config.Name: Trust Proxy Headers
Config.Description: Set to true when behind a reverse proxy so login rate limiting reads X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP

Config.Name: OIDC Auto-Provision
Config.Description: Set to true to auto-create household member accounts on OIDC login

Config.Name: LLM Provider
Config.Description: Optional: anthropic, openai, gemini, or openai-compatible (e.g. Ollama)

Config.Name: LLM Base URL
Config.Description: Optional custom API base URL (e.g. http://ollama:11434/v1)
